subject: Compressed MAP: security gates, retention windows, and evidence handoff
messages:
From: Carlos Vega <security@optimabank.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Rios <maya.rios@optimabank.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jan 2028 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff – security intake + retention questions

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for the walkthrough earlier. As we compress our evaluation to ~3 weeks we need to lock the security gates and retention windows in the MAP before the exec review next Friday. Couple of asks from our InfoSec intake: 

- Latest SOC 2 report (scope: infrastructure + platform) and date of last audit.
- Completed SIG/CAIQ spreadsheet for our control mapping.
- Draft DPA with retention carveouts and a clear default retention policy for customer data (we default to 90 days, but need clarity around logs and KV cache exports).

If you can provide artifacts and a proposed MAP milestone table (what we need by day 3/7/14/21) that will help us confirm go/no-go internally.

Thanks,
Carlos Vega
Head of Information Security
OptimaBank

--

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 10 Jan 2028 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff – security intake + retention questions

Carlos — really appreciate the clarity. High level response and next steps below; I copied Ben (Sales Eng) and Laura (Legal) for artifacts / DPA redline.

Quick answers:
- SOC 2: we can share our audited report (SOC 2 Type II, Q3 2027) and auditor contact. See attached.
- SIG/CAIQ: Ben will complete the mapping and return within 48 hours.
- DPA & retention: Laura is tracking the client DPA redline and can confirm our standard retention buckets. Our default platform retention for request/response logs is 90 days; we can offer a 180-day retention option on a paid tier for dedicated/private deployments.

Proposed compressed MAP milestones (target close in 3 weeks):
1) Day 2 — share SOC2 + SIG mapping draft + DPA redline v1 (attachments).
2) Day 7 — evidence review call, outstanding control gaps flagged, list of quick mitigations.
3) Day 14 — finalize DPA terms and retention windows; sign DocuSign for PO or commitment.
4) Day 21 — final acceptance and production onboarding kickoff.

If that aligns, we will officially add these milestones to the MAP and assign owners.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Carlos / Maya — attaching the SIG/CAIQ mapping I started. High level notes:
- Controls flagged in yellow are evidence we can deliver in 48–72 hours (audit logs, RBAC screenshots, encryption at rest configs).
- A few controls will need engineering confirmations (real-time KV cache persistence behavior, policy for manual exports). Those are flagged in red — Rishi can own confirmations.

Proposed mitigation for the retention ask:
- Offer an interim export for audit purposes: we can provide a one-time encrypted export of historical request logs covering the evaluation window upon signed NDA/PoA.
- For production, commit to default 90-day logs, with paid 180-day retention for Dedicated/Private.

I'll be available for the evidence review call on Friday.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Carlos — attaching the DPA with our standard text and the redlines addressing Optima's notes. Two points to highlight:

1) Retention carveouts: our standard DPA has retention surface areas for customer content and logs. We've accepted the 90-day default for logs in our template; Optima's request for longer retention is an option we can accommodate on Dedicated/Private with an addendum.

2) Audit access: we are not doing on-prem audits but will provide SOC 2 report and an auditor contact. For additional evidence we will provide exports and snapshots as agreed in the MAP.

If Optima needs a contractual commitment to a 180-day retention on Hosted, we need to escalate to Revenue Ops — that will affect pricing and compliance review.

Happy to discuss on Friday during the evidence review.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Head of Legal Operations
Redwood Inference

Carlos / Maya — quick wrap and agreed next steps after our evidence review call today: 

Summary of commitments: 
- We delivered: SOC 2 (Q3 2027), completed SIG/CAIQ draft, and DPA redline v2 (attachments delivered).
- Evidence handoff: Redwood will provide an encrypted one-time export of request logs covering the evaluation period within 48 hours of a signed NDA/POA. (Owner: Ben)
- Retention: Redwood confirms default 90-day request/response logs for Hosted. Optima may select 180-day retention as a paid option for Dedicated/Private. For an exception to 180 days on Hosted, we require Revenue Ops approval and a priced addendum. (Owner: Laura to scope contractual language; Tessa to coordinate pricing ask with Sales Ops.)
- Outstanding engineering checks: Rishi will confirm KV cache persistence/eviction artifacts and provide a short runbook by EOD Wednesday.

Next administrative steps: 
1) Carlos to confirm NDA/POA so Ben can kick off the export (target: Tue 18 Jan).
2) Optima to sign DPA redline v2 or provide specific clause asks by Thu 20 Jan.
3) Tessa to update the MAP in HubSpot and add milestone owners (Doc link: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/HS-45892).

If Optima signs by Jan 21 we remain on track for the production onboarding kickoff on Jan 31 (21-day MAP).

Thanks everyone — will follow up if anything slips.

—
Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Executive, Financials BU
Redwood Inference
